summary: The Houston Public Library emphasizes the importance of E-Rate for maintaining affordable connectivity and modern infrastructure in its libraries. It highlights the ongoing need for E-Rate funding to support equipment upgrades, network infrastructure, and connectivity services. The library relies on the 90% discount on monthly internet service and 85% discount on infrastructure hardware provided by E-Rate to keep its doors open and provide modern connectivity to its patrons. The Houston Public Library discusses the importance of E-Rate and CIPA in maintaining internet safety and accessibility for its patrons. It highlights the need for network-level filtering to protect patron-owned devices and ensure a safe environment. The library opposes extending CIPA to third-party-owned devices as it would violate privacy and free expression rights of patrons.
